body:
**Summary**

Fix #2386 

- The boundaries were ignored in `getConfiguration` for the first render
- They were ignored when a refinement was triggered and reset

**Result**

You can play with the `RangeSlider` on `dev-novel` (some stories added)

comments.body:
Deploy preview ready!

Built with commit 87a5e974df9e222076656d330869e64931bd8282

https://deploy-preview-2408--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

I found a bug.
https://deploy-preview-2408--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default 

- set the price slider to > 2000 (2000 is the min)
- type 'mg'
- end up a slider with range outside the min max returned by the results
- remove the query
- range is now 600 - 2000

@bobylito I fixed the bug, but I still need to dig a little bit to find a way to allow `refine` on first rendering. Because I based the refinement on the `range` and on the first rendering we have a range of [0, 0] (default value). So, the refinement can't be done properly for the `max` value. It will always be upper than the max bound.

Now the values are clamp inside the range for `RangeSlider`, avoids some rendering trouble (notice the slider bar when the range changes).

**Before:**
![with-out-range](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6513513/31008700-531e9998-a505-11e7-838d-992749e3af15.gif)

**After:**
![without-out-range](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6513513/31008710-5b1d7f38-a505-11e7-9015-d09c70714405.gif)
